behavior.canary: stack canary at rsp+0xb8, checked before return; __stack_chk_fail at 0x5eee307 on mismatch
behavior.dash_length: the dash string is built with _M_construct(length = row snprintf's would-be length, '-') and printed with "%s\n", so the underline is exactly as long as the row including the row's trailing newline
behavior.ignored_argument: the fourth argument (rcx) is never read: the formatter overwrites rcx with -1 for the first snprintf_chk call
behavior.label_argument: the row's first %s is *(rdx): the caller passes a stack std::string whose data pointer is its first qword; the two observed calls pass "Level" and "Priority"
behavior.name_argument: the title's %s is rsi, supplied by the caller as *( *(owner+0x788) + 0x08 ); it is an opaque caller-supplied char*, not pinned to a named object in this packet
behavior.output: title line, then the 21-column header row, then a dash line, all written into the caller's character buffer (the big dump caller's stack buffer at rsp+0x4c0, 2024 bytes) and appended by the caller with string::append(const char*)
behavior.snprintf_budget: each of the three __snprintf_chk calls uses a 2000-byte budget (0x7d0): the title is written at buf+0 with maxlen 2000, the row at buf+min(title_would_be, 2000) with maxlen 2000-min(title_would_be, 2000), the dash line at buf+min(title_would_be+row_would_be, 2000) with the remaining maxlen. A call writes at most maxlen-1 characters plus the terminating NUL and reports the would-be length.
behavior.throw: any looked-up key missing from the pair map throws __throw_out_of_range("map::at") at 0x5eee2e8 (name_getter's own throw, or the inlined find's jump to the same throw)

bounded_question: What does the node #115 compaction-stats table header formatter (0x5eedda0) write into the caller's buffer, and in what order do its 21 header-row columns come from the global pair map?

columns.derivation: The 13 map::at calls pin keys 21, 20, 17, 15, 14, 13, 12, 11, 10, 9, 6, 3, 1. The 7 inlined lower_bound + equality lookups pin keys 19, 18, 16, 8, 7, 5, 4: each loop compares against key-1 with jle (lower_bound(key)) and the check compares against key with jg to the throw at 0x5eee2e8, so the accepted key is exactly the check constant. The 20 stack varargs are pushed in reverse order, so the row order is the label (r9 = *(rdx)) followed by keys 1, 3..21. verify.py re-derives this order from main.txt. Key 2 is never looked up, so a table without it renders identically.
columns.key_two_absent: key 2 ("CompactedFiles") is never read by the formatter; its absence cannot throw
columns.row_separators: 4 spaces after column 1, 3 after column 2, 5 after column 3, 1 after column 4, 2 after column 5, then single spaces

context_map.built_by: static initializer 0x5efbd80: 21 {int, string, string} entries (stride 0x48) pair_range_inserted via 0x5ef0ea0 (count 21, first = -0x1900(%rbp))
context_map.node_layout: header 32 B; int key @+0x20; first string @+0x28 (ptr @+0x28, size @+0x30, SSO @+0x38); second string @+0x48 (ptr @+0x48, size @+0x50, SSO @+0x58)
context_map.note: RocksDB-style compaction-stats column headers (short name, display name).
context_map.read_by_formatter: the SECOND string only, through map::at (0x5eeb7f0) and seven inlined lower_bound + equality lookups; name_getter returns &pair, and pair+0x20 is the second string's data pointer
context_map.read_by_sibling_consumer: the FIRST string only (PR #3164's consumer 0x5efa010 uses the first strings as map keys)

formatter.returns: void (writes into the caller's buffer; rax is 0 on return)
formatter.signature: f(out=rdi: char*, name=rsi: char*, label_ptr=rdx: char**, ignored=rcx)

initializer.note: Static initializer: builds the 21-entry pair table on the stack (stride 0x48, keys 1..21) and pair_range-inserts it into the global pair map at 0x6503a00 via 0x5ef0ea0. 0 direct calls; one tail jump at 0x5effdc4.

name_getter.note: std::map<int, std::pair<std::string, std::string>>::at for the pair map: lower_bound(key) + equality check; returns &value (the pair) and throws __throw_out_of_range("map::at") when the key is missing. 13 call sites, all inside the formatter.

string_assign.note: std::string::assign(const char*): assigns a .rodata literal to a std::string. Used by the initializer to build the pair table and by the big dump caller to set the label string ("Level" at 0x5ef6736, "Priority" at 0x5ef7114).

unknowns: What object *(owner+0x788) points to and what its +0x08 char* names: the formatter only uses it as the title's %s, so the model takes the name as an input.

The big dump caller 0x5ef66e0..0x5ef8049 body is not pinned beyond the two site windows; the per-level data-row formatter 0x5eed6f0 (called at 0x5ef6b84, 0x5ef6e09, 0x5ef70de, 0x5ef72dd) is a separate candidate, not modelled here.

The formatter's buffer is the caller's 2024-byte stack buffer; the formatter's own writes never pass offset 2000, but the caller's buffer size is inferred from the frame layout (0xca8 - 0x4c0), not from a stated allocation.
